choose
選擇
How would you choose between a familiar activity and trying something new?
I would choose something new if I had the energy to enjoy it. On an exhausting week, a familiar activity might suit me better.
有精神好好體驗，我會選擇新活動。如果那週很累，熟悉的安排可能更適合。
option
選項
What would you do if none of the available options met all your needs?
I would identify which need mattered most before choosing an option. I could accept a smaller compromise on less important details.
決定選哪個選項前，我會先找出最重要的需求。不那麼關鍵的細節，就接受一點取捨。
alternative
替代方案
Your original plan is no longer possible. How would you find a useful alternative?
I would look for an alternative that kept the main purpose of the plan. The replacement would not need to copy every detail.
我會找能保留原本主要目的的替代方案。新的安排，不必每個細節都一樣。
priority
優先
How would you decide on a priority when several people wanted your help?
I would make the most urgent, important request my priority. I would tell the others when I could realistically help them.
我會優先處理最急也最重要的請求。其他人那邊，也說清楚自己何時真的能幫忙。
urgent
緊急
How do you distinguish an urgent request from one that only sounds urgent?
I ask what will happen if the urgent request waits. A clear consequence helps me judge the timing better than dramatic wording.
我會問這件緊急請求如果晚點處理，會發生什麼。實際後果，比誇張的措辭更能判斷。
important
重要
What important activity is easy to postpone because it has no deadline?
Keeping in touch with relatives is important but easy to postpone. I would put a regular call in my calendar to protect the time.
和親人聯繫很重要，卻常因沒期限而一直拖。我會把固定通話排進行事曆。
necessary
必要
How would you decide whether an extra purchase was necessary for a project?
I would ask whether the purchase was necessary for the intended result. If existing tools could do the job, I would use them first.
我會先問，這筆購買對成果是否必要。原有工具能完成的話，就先用現成的。
essential
不可或缺
Which item would be essential on a day when you had to travel very lightly?
My phone with saved tickets would be essential for that journey. I would also keep the most important travel details on paper.
那趟路上，存好車票的手機不可或缺。我也會把最重要的交通資料寫在紙上。
benefit
好處
What is the biggest benefit of living close to your school?
The biggest benefit is that I can sleep a little longer every morning. I also do not have to squeeze onto a crowded bus after a long day.
最大的好處是每天早上可以多睡一下。放學累了一整天，也不用再去擠公車。
drawback
缺點
What drawback would make you say no to joining a club you like?
One big drawback would be practices every weekend. Even if I liked the club, I would not have enough time to study or rest.
一個很大的缺點是每個週末都要練習。就算我喜歡這個社團，也會沒時間讀書和休息。
advantage
優勢
What advantage could a smaller team have over a larger one?
A smaller team may have the advantage of quicker communication. That only helps if members still have the skills and time the work needs.
小團隊的優勢，可能是溝通比較快。但人員仍要有足夠的能力和時間，才有用。
disadvantage
劣勢
How could you reduce the disadvantage of being new to a group?
I could reduce that disadvantage by asking for the group's shared notes. A clear introduction to their routines would help me contribute sooner.
我可以先請大家分享共用筆記，降低剛加入的劣勢。了解大家的日常做法，也能更快幫上忙。
compare
比較
How would you compare two courses that advertised very different strengths?
I would compare them using the same personal goal. Looking at sample lessons would help me judge beyond their advertising claims.
我會用自己的同一個目標比較兩門課。先看試聽內容，就不只靠廣告來判斷。
evaluate
評估
How would you evaluate whether a new study method is really working for you?
I would evaluate it by comparing my quiz scores from the two weeks before and after. I would also notice whether I can remember new words more easily.
我會比較用這個方法前後兩週的小考成績來評估。也會注意自己是不是比較容易記住新單字。
consider
考慮
What would you consider before agreeing to a long-term commitment?
I would consider how much time the commitment would require each week. I would also ask what happens if my circumstances change.
我會考慮每週要投入多少時間。也先問，如果生活狀況改變，後續能怎麼調整。
consequence
後果
What possible consequence would you think about before cancelling a shared booking?
One consequence could be leaving friends with a larger bill. I would check the cancellation terms and discuss the change before acting.
可能的後果，是朋友得多分攤費用。我會先看取消條款，也先和大家商量。
trade
換取
What convenience would you trade for a lower price when you travel?
On a long trip, I would trade a faster train ride for a cheaper bus ticket. Sitting for an extra hour is fine if I can save a lot of money.
長途旅行時，我願意多花點時間搭客運，換取比較便宜的票價。多坐一個小時沒關係，只要能省下不少錢。
accept
接受
When might you accept a result that is good enough rather than perfect?
I would accept a clear, accurate report even if its layout was simple. Improving decoration should not delay information someone urgently needs.
內容清楚準確的報告，版面簡單我也能接受。不能為了裝飾，耽誤別人急需的資訊。
refuse
拒絕
How would you refuse a request that conflicts with an earlier promise?
I would refuse politely and explain that I had already committed elsewhere. I could suggest another person only if they were happy to help.
我會客氣地拒絕，說明自己先前已有承諾。要介紹別人幫忙，也先確認對方願意。
agree
同意
What would you need to understand before you agree to a group decision?
Before I agree, I would want to understand the responsibilities and costs. Being quiet during a discussion should not be mistaken for consent.
同意之前，我想先弄清楚責任和費用。討論時沒說話，不應該就被當成答應。
permission
允許
When would you ask for permission before sharing something?
I would ask permission before sharing a friend's personal story. Removing their name might not prevent others from recognizing them.
分享朋友的私事前，我會先問他是否允許。就算拿掉名字，別人還是可能認得出來。
independent
獨立
What helped you become more independent in an everyday task?
Learning to plan meals made me more independent. I could shop and cook for myself without waiting for someone else to organize dinner.
學會安排三餐，讓我更獨立。我能自己採買、煮飯，不必等別人張羅晚餐。
depend
依靠
Which task would you rather learn yourself than depend on someone else for?
I would rather learn simple clothing repairs than depend on others. Sewing on a button would save a small but repeated inconvenience.
我想學簡單的衣物修補，不必一直依靠別人。光是會縫扣子，就能少掉常遇到的小麻煩。
commit
承諾
How do you avoid promising more than you can commit to?
I check my existing responsibilities before I commit to something new. Offering a smaller, reliable contribution is better than repeatedly letting people down.
答應新事情前，我會先看原有責任。不勉強承諾，穩定做好一小部分，比常讓人失望好。
